title: Regen Engineering knowledge.lock
description: Regeneration lineage for one module: what knowledge and which model produced the current implementation.

module.description: Module name. Must match the directory that owns this lock file.

stack.description: Implementation this lock describes, e.g. typescript. Required when a module has more than one implementation, in which case each lock is named knowledge.<stack>.lock.

knowledge_version.description: Git commit hash of the knowledge tree this implementation was generated from.

generated_by.description: Model or tool identifier, e.g. claude-fable-5.

contracts_passed.description: Contract IDs green at generation time.

drift.description: none: in sync. code-ahead: implementation changed without a knowledge delta, a defect. knowledge-ahead: knowledge changed, regeneration pending, a backlog.

drift_debt.description: Present only when drift is code-ahead and was accepted deliberately, e.g. an emergency hotfix awaiting reconciliation.
